name: Riba-roja d'Ebre (Spain)
description: Red field with a white wavy stripe near the lower edge, charged at the upper hoist with a white Maltese cross.
history: The official flag of Riba-roja d'Ebre is of heraldic origin: oblong, of proportions two high by three long, red, with a white wavy fess of width 1/6 of the height placed at an equal distance from the lower edge, and at the hoist corner a white Maltese cross of height 1/2 of the flag; published in the DOGC on 9 December 1992.

features.role: wavy fess of 1/6 of the height near the lower edge
Maltese cross of 1/2 of the height at the upper hoist
